modelResolution: Existing per-user .local\models\<pinned-model-name> takes precedence; otherwise use installed models. Explicit provisioning writes only to per-user models. All selected files must pass the same pinned manifest.

managerExitCodes.0: Operation completed; status may indicate not listening.
managerExitCodes.1: Operation refused or failed; no unrelated process was terminated.

applicationEnvironment.PHANTOM_TRANSCRIPTION_TOKEN: Existing locally generated token, never a command argument

tokenProvisioning.encoding: 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters, without BOM
tokenProvisioning.creation: Owner-SID-only DACL; CreateNew; retain and validate existing token.

managerOutput: Human-readable bounded text, except listening status JSON; use exit code, not English text parsing.
timeoutPolicy: Do not kill a detached service or remove its receipt on launcher timeout.

launcherMaintenance.transport: Native authenticated loopback HTTP GET /v1/runtime and POST /v1/shutdown; never a Python maintenance command.
launcherMaintenance.coordination: Current-user installed workspace and its existing token/receipt; shared byte-range lifecycle lock.
launcherMaintenance.staleReceiptPolicy: Only remove an unchanged receipt after Windows proves the recorded process absent or its creation identity changed. Ambiguous live ownership fails closed; never kill by PID.
launcherMaintenance.exitPolicy: Exit 0 permits maintenance; any nonzero exit blocks replacement or uninstall. Preserve user data in either case.

uninstallPolicy: Refuse active/foreign service; preserve InstalledRuntime and all user data. No purge by default.
capturePolicy: Idle service startup never opens an audio endpoint; capture requires explicit app Start.
redistributionPolicy: No internal Agency/provider binaries, auth, personal config or caches.
